title: Museum Audio-Guide Builder
originalRequest: Develop an administrative panel and visitor-facing web app for hosting, mapping, and synthesizing museum exhibit audio guides.
latestMessage: Develop an administrative panel and visitor-facing web app for hosting, mapping, and synthesizing museum exhibit audio guides.

steps.title: Configure Backend Audio Synthesis Module
steps.instruction: Integrate Azure Speech API or AWS Polly to synthesize text descriptions of museum exhibits into MP3 audio streams on demand.
steps.acceptance: API triggers synthesis, saves the resulting audio payload to S3, and returns the public file URL with a 200 OK status code.
steps.result: Agent joker-codex (Attempt 1, Medium difficulty, Status: Doing): I have established the core connection to the synthesis API and configured S3 upload handlers. I am currently debugging rate-limiting and chunking logic for descriptions exceeding 3000 characters. S3 asset generation is working for smaller payloads, but standard error handling for API timeouts is still in progress.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Floorplan Mapping System
steps.instruction: Create a canvas-based coordinate mapper in the admin dashboard allowing curators to overlay interactive nodes on uploaded floorplan images.
steps.acceptance: Curators can plot coordinate vertices, save polygonal zones linked to specific exhibit IDs, and serialize the coordinates to PostgreSQL.

steps.title: Implement Exhibit QR Code Generator Utility
steps.instruction: Implement a QR code utility that automatically renders printable vectors linking directly to the visitor player URL for individual exhibits.
steps.acceptance: Endpoint accepts exhibit ID, generates high-resolution SVG or PNG QR code, and allows batch downloads in PDF format with exhibit titles.

steps.title: Design PWA Audio Player with Offline Support
steps.instruction: Build a progressive web application player for visitors that utilizes service workers to cache synthesized audio assets locally.
steps.acceptance: The application loads exhibit pages instantly under weak connection profiles and caches audio payloads locally during initial scan.
